newsitem.title: USA: Regal Hotels eyes U.S. acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Regal Hotels eyes U.S. acquisition.

text.p: Regal Hotels International Holdings Ltd said it is eyeing new acquisitions in the United States and may soon zoom in on one in New York, said director John Poon.
Speaking at a Jerdine Fleming Asia conference in New York, Poon said: "I wouldn't be surprise if Regal's next acquisition, a major acquisition, will be right here in New York."
He identified San Francisco as being another city for acquisitions, but did not reveal any names.
Regal, through its 95 percent owned Richfield subsidiary, has ownership or long-term lease interest in 28 hotels and resorts in the U.S.
Poon also said the company was seeking to expand in Europe, particularly in a key city like London and Paris.
He said the company was still mulling a possible floatation of its U.S interests, but did not have a fixed timetable at this time.
Regal Hotels' parent company is Century City International Holdings Ltd.
